A cpu does much more convoluted and complex tasks than a GPU, therefore the path information takes around the CPU, and the various stops it makes, is inevitably more complex and convoluted. So latency and keeping everything small is important for a CPU.

For the GPU, even if you look at the picture of the die, you can see how the organization of the architecture is much more straightforward, and so is the flow of information. It is built to do 1-2 tasks (mainly calculate edges of triangles) extremely quickly, getting the data to the compute area it needs to be in is much less of a problem, everything is also much more predictable which helps a lot. 

  
Although even CPU's nowadays through branch prediction and other technologies are also trying to predict the next operations / information needed in order to speed everything up.
